events.evidence: Russia says it will temporarily block Chinese citizens beginning on February 20 from entering its territory as authorities look to stem the spread of the pandemic
The U.S. State Department adds Russian oil company Rosneft Trading S.A. to its financial blacklist for helping facilitate the sale of Venezuelan oil
American retailer Macy's announces it will close 125 stores over the next three years, citing competition from online sellers

label.note: COVID-19 border restrictions, Rosneft sanctions and retail closures add modest adverse pressure.
